analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. It edits the sampling-defaults table row at line 1841 and the paragraph around lines 1864-1871. The text now says the catalog Qwen3.5-9B, qwen3.5-35b-a3b and qwen3.6-35b-a3b-vl-mtp-mxfp8 builds take model-card defaults when a request omits knobs: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, presence_penalty 1.5. The change is described as bound to model_type, with explicit request values still winning. I checked this against the threat model. It touches no authorization, attestation, encryption, key custody, or coordinator-provider wire handling. Sampler defaults are not part of prompt or cache identity (the doc states this at lines ~1893-1895), so the T-041 prefix-cache scoping and SSD HMAC posture is unaffected. T-007 (provider tampering with outputs) is unaffected because the provider is already untrusted for output integrity. The head side of the code change (EngineV2SamplingDefaults.qwen35CardDefaults) is not supplied. Whether default non-greedy sampling interacts with MTP acceptance or the JSON-constrained Qwen path (grammar-constrained, no drafting) cannot be verified from this doc. That is a correctness and performance question, not a security regression. A possible integration question is whether the sampler-default change alters the cache identity. The doc says it does not, and the code is not in this batch. No findings.
